description: Current Bitcoin (BTC) spot price in USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, CHF, AUD and JPY, averaged across major exchanges, with the number of satoshis per US dollar and the time of the price. Use to convert between sats and fiat, to value a Bitcoin or Lightning payment, or to check the BTC price before a trade. Costs $0.001 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
